title: The Help strip is as wide as the chat box, and a Help row is drawn once after a host command opens the transcript
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/help-ui.test.mjs packages/ui/tracy-assistant/test/dock-phase.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the case named under expect.

S3 (stand, tasks/bang-chung/lan-6-help-thang-hang-o-chat/): dsh built with this change + tracy-web. On a site with an empty session type /help and press Enter at window widths 1440, 1200, 1000, 800, 700 and 520, and read the left edge of the first suggested question against the left edge of the chat box card.
S4 (stand, tasks/bang-chung/lan-6-help-thang-hang-o-chat/): on a site with an empty session run /compact, then /help What can Tracy do?, and count the Help question rows and Tip rows on the page.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'; the case "the Help strip is as wide as the chat box" is 'ok': .tv-help-dock takes its max-width from --dsh-composer-card-max-width plus twice --dsh-composer-side-clearance, pads by the clearance plus 16px, and has no fixed pixel max-width.
S3: at every width the first suggested question starts 16px inside the chat box card (before: +59px at 1440, -17px at 1200, -44px at 1000).

S1 also: 'a host command opened the transcript (an active target) while the session is still blank: the strip steps aside' is 'ok'. S4: one question row and one Tip row (before: two of each, the second answer cut at the top), and no Help row inside the strip.
evidence: 08/10/2026: after typing /help and Enter the suggested questions and the Discord link sat off the chat box. Evidence: tasks/bang-chung/lan-6-help-thang-hang-o-chat/KET-QUA.md. Second defect found while re-checking: after /compact then /help <q> every Help row was drawn twice (strip and transcript); measured tips 2, questions 2 before, tips 1, questions 1 after.
fence: Only the width and side padding of the Help strip change, and the strip steps aside when dsh draws the transcript; Help's rows, their order and what Help says are untouched.

tests: the Help strip is as wide as the chat box
a host command opened the transcript
a blank session with nothing started
